epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease average pipeline stall time from >3 cycles to 0 cycles
requirements: R1: Patch the existing task processing logic to correctly transition tasks out of the 'pending_review' state and unlock the completion of the final two deliverables.

slices.title: Fix pending_review task transition processing
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pipeline unblocking patch for this epic, I want the task processor to correctly handle the 'pending_review' state transition, so that the workflow continues without manual intervention.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task is in the 'pending_review' state,
When the task is processed by the pipeline,
Then it should successfully transition to the next valid state.
Given the deliverables are blocked at 11/13 readiness,
When the stalled task is unblocked,
Then the deliverable readiness should advance accordingly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of tasks stalled in pending_review across consecutive cycles from 1 to 0
